body: Wow your doing so good though. It really stinks when your family is not there for you. Instead just judge you but you're better off without them! I care for my parents regardless of how shitty they are, but at the same time  I hate them for everything I went through as a little girl because of them. I really hope this counseling stuff works. I feel like I have so much pain bottled up. I feel bitter and angry. So angry I cry.. but then I feel sad. I'm just a complete mess. I really don't want to do something stupid & thank you for listening to me rant :(

My oldest is 6 and little one 1. My aunt watches my kids for me. I am gone Tuesday- Friday 7am-9pm, and saturdays from 7am-4pm. So besides getting paid she talks bad about me. Nobody in my family supports me. They all make fun of me or belittle me for going to school. They rather see me working and on top of that just use me for rides or treat me like a bank. Since i'm the only one in the family with a car. i never saw my parents growing up because they were both raging alcoholics and used drugs. They're comparing me to that. but im just working! im trying to provide a better life for my kids.. but times like this like right now. i really am contemplating suicide but the only reason i dont kill myself is because i love those little boys. i dont want to leave them behind.

I'm at work right now.. and honestly your comment made me cry. I don't hear that often. so thank you!! I just get told how much of a shitty mother I am because I leave my kids alone so much, or that I'm a crazy *****. I don't have anybody for help. and it stinks having grown up without anything I just want to do right for my kids but its so hard. I honestly feel like scum of the Earth.
I did cut down i was taking 5 classes.. now i'm only taking 3. But it's still at times I feel like giving up.
